segments.1TI.1.3-4: Paul tells Timothy to stop false teaching in Ephesus
segments.1TI.1.5-8: Paul says the goal is love, but some turn to empty talk
segments.1TI.1.9-11: Paul says the law is for the lawless and sinful
segments.1TI.1.12-14: Paul thanks Christ Jesus for showing him mercy
segments.1TI.1.15-17: Christ Jesus came to save sinners, even Paul
segments.1TI.1.18-20: Paul charges Timothy to fight well and keep faith
segments.1TI.2.1-4: Paul urges believers to pray for everyone, even kings
segments.1TI.2.5-7: There is one God and one mediator, Christ Jesus
segments.1TI.2.8-8: Paul wants men everywhere to pray without anger
segments.1TI.2.9-10: Paul wants women to dress modestly and do good deeds
segments.1TI.2.11-12: Paul says women must learn quietly, not teach or rule men
segments.1TI.2.13-15: Paul points to Adam and Eve and to women’s faith
segments.1TI.3.1-3: An overseer must be above reproach and of good character
segments.1TI.3.4-5: An overseer must manage his own household well
segments.1TI.3.6-7: Overseers must not be new believers and must be respected
segments.1TI.3.8-10: Deacons must be dignified, honest, and tested first
segments.1TI.3.11-13: The women and deacons must be dignified and faithful
segments.1TI.3.14-15: Paul writes how believers should act in the church
segments.1TI.3.16-16: Christ appeared in the flesh and was taken up in glory
segments.1TI.4.1-2: The Spirit says some will leave the faith in later times
segments.1TI.4.3-5: False teachers forbid marriage and some foods
segments.1TI.4.6-8: Timothy should reject myths and train for godliness
segments.1TI.4.9-10: Paul works hard because he hopes in the living God
segments.1TI.4.11-13: Timothy must be an example for the believers
segments.1TI.4.14-16: Timothy must use his gift and watch his teaching
segments.1TI.5.3-4: Children and grandchildren must care for widows
segments.1TI.5.5-6: A widow in need hopes in God and prays day and night
segments.1TI.5.7-8: Anyone who does not provide for family denies the faith
segments.1TI.5.9-10: Widows over sixty with good deeds may be enrolled
segments.1TI.5.11-13: Timothy should not enroll younger widows
segments.1TI.5.14-16: Younger widows should marry and manage a home
segments.1TI.5.17-18: Elders who lead well deserve double honor
segments.1TI.5.19-20: Timothy must be careful with accusations against elders
segments.1TI.5.21-22: Paul charges Timothy to be fair and stay pure
segments.1TI.6.6-8: Believers should be content with food and clothing
segments.1TI.6.9-10: Loving money leads people into ruin and sorrow
segments.1TI.6.11-12: Timothy must run from evil and pursue godliness
segments.1TI.6.13-14: Paul charges Timothy to keep the commandment
segments.1TI.6.15-16: Paul praises God, the only King and Lord
